scope: Google Search Console only (90 snapshots, 2026-05-07 to 2026-08-17) joined to the 83-keyword master tracker. Competitor #1-blocker analysis and AI/LLM visibility are NOT included here and remain manual research; GSC and GA4 cannot produce them honestly.
wins: Top-of-page presence improved vs the last run (2026-08-13): the #1 tier went 0 to 1 and #2-3 went 1 to 2. "bariatric therapy" now holds avg position 1.0 and "bariatric counseling" sits at 1.9 on 13 impressions - the latter is the strongest tracked term with real impression volume, and it has come from 25.0 on 2026-05-07 and 17.2 on 2026-07-04.

"food addiction treatment" is the biggest mover of the run: +13.2 positions (58.8 to 45.7) on 9 impressions, and +14.6 since the 2026-07-04 reference (60.3). This is BCC's strategic differentiation lane, so movement here matters more than the raw number suggests.

The San Antonio eating-disorder cluster is climbing together: "eating disorder counseling san antonio" +1.7 (16.2 to 14.5, 15 impressions), "eating disorder therapist san antonio" +2.5 (17.2 to 14.7, 14 impressions), "eating disorder treatment san antonio" +2.0 (19.5 to 17.5). All three are roughly 9-11 positions better than their 2026-07-04 reference. These are the highest-impression tracked local terms.

Aggregate visibility improved over the last four days: impressions 1,585 to 1,685 and impression-weighted avg position 19.77 to 18.03 between the 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-17 snapshots. The hydration blog post remains the site's visibility engine at 7,945 impressions and 24 clicks at avg position 7.2, roughly 65% of all page-level impressions in the window.
needs_attention: Keyword coverage: 15 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show GSC impressions; 68 show none. This is a KEYWORD count, not a page count and not a count of unpublished pages. The tracker maps those 83 keywords onto 50 distinct target pages, 49 of which already point at live www URLs - only 1 (staging12 /what-is-a-bariatric-counselor/) still points at staging. Tracker hygiene is nearly clean; the zero-impression terms are mostly genuine ranking gaps, not broken pointers.

"bariatric psychological evaluation near me" is the most meaningful slip: -7.9 positions (24.7 to 32.6) on 14 impressions, one of the highest-impression tracked terms. This is a bottom-of-funnel commercial term where BCC should be competitive, and the loss is large enough not to be snapshot noise.

CTR is the core problem, not visibility. Page-level totals for the window are 12,268 impressions against 37 clicks - roughly 0.30%. The sleep post pulled 1,076 impressions at avg position 12.7 with 0 clicks, and the weight-loss-medications post 753 impressions at 10.7 with 1 click. Traffic is arriving at informational blog posts that do not convert into service-page visits. (Note: the query-dimension summary shows only 1,685 impressions / 13 clicks because it is capped at 500 query rows and undercounts; page-level is the true total.)

Long-window drift is negative even though the short window is positive: from the first snapshot (2026-05-07) to today, impressions fell 2,447 to 1,685 and avg position worsened 14.87 to 18.03 on the query dimension. Clicks did rise 2 to 13 over the same span, so the site is converting a smaller footprint better.

Several tracked terms sit on 1-3 impressions ("bariatric therapy" 1, "bariatric counseling near me" 2, "bariatric surgery counseling" 1, "bariatric therapist" 3). Positions at that volume swing day to day and are directional only - do not read a single-impression #1 as a durable ranking.
priority_actions: Fix the CTR gap first: add explicit consult CTAs and contextual internal links from the four highest-impression blog posts (hydration 7,945 imp, sleep 1,076, weight-loss medications 753, gastroparesis 644) into the matching service pages. These four carry ~84% of page-level impressions and produce 27 of 37 clicks; even a small lift here beats any new ranking gain.

Diagnose and refresh the "bariatric psychological evaluation near me" target page - the -7.9 slip on 14 impressions is the single largest commercial loss this run. Check title/H1 intent match, add a clear pre-surgical psych-eval FAQ block, and confirm the page is internally linked from the bariatric service pages.

Repoint the one remaining staging targetUrl in keywords-master.json (staging12 /what-is-a-bariatric-counselor/) to its live www equivalent so GSC can match it. Verify the live slug first rather than assuming - past checks found staging-targeted slugs already live verbatim or under a different slug.

Defend the newly won top-of-page terms - "bariatric therapy" (#1) and "bariatric counseling" (1.9) - with a freshness pass and FAQ schema on their target pages. FAQ schema also buys rich-result and AI-overview eligibility, which is where these low-volume, high-intent national terms actually get seen.

Push the food-addiction cluster while it is moving: "food addiction treatment" gained 13.2 positions but still sits at 45.7. Build out supporting content and internal links from the emotional-eating post (178 imp at position 42.3, currently orphaned in the rankings) into the food-addiction service page.
Competitor #1-blocker and AI/LLM visibility remain manual. If those dashboard sections matter this cycle, they need a hand-run SERP and AI-answer sweep - GSC cannot produce them.
summary: Short-term visibility is up (impressions 1,585 to 1,685, avg position 19.77 to 18.03 since 2026-08-13) with the #1 tier reoccupied by "bariatric therapy" and the San Antonio eating-disorder cluster climbing together, but 68 of 83 tracked keywords still show zero impressions and page-level CTR is only 0.30% (37 clicks on 12,268 impressions). The highest-leverage work is converting existing blog traffic into service-page visits and recovering "bariatric psychological evaluation near me", which slipped 7.9 positions on real impression volume.
